Lawson vs Lindblad — Racing Bulls had upgraded car; watch which driver gets the new spec parts and benefits more at Zandvoort
Williams rumored Baku upgrade — but Albon is pessimistic, suggesting Williams may fall further behind Aston Martin in the second half
arc: The Dutch GP is the first race after the summer break and a critical sprint weekend that all channels are planning around. It represents the last realistic week to hold Hadjar before his rolling average deteriorates, making it a natural transition point toward 4A lineups for those with ~123-128M budgets. Aston Martin's double upgrade (aero from Hungary + Honda engine at Zandvoort) could reshape the midfield value landscape — if Alonso and Stroll start scoring consistently, they become elite budget enablers that fund premium 4A cores. The sprint format at Zandvoort makes it one of the highest-ceiling weekends of the season (sprints have produced the four highest-scoring weekends of 2026), creating ideal conditions for aggressive chip usage (3x Boost or No Negative). Looking ahead, Monza follows as a power circuit that could favor different constructors, and Singapore after that is a street circuit where 3x could also work — but the consensus leans toward deploying offensive chips at Zandvoort's sprint to maximize the multiplied scoring opportunities.
